alate: Alate: the ocellus is rather well developed, its short diameter and the distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket broadly corresponding, the two nearly equal in length. The compound eye is situated rather low, the distance from the lower margin of the compound eye to the lower margin of the head capsule equal to the diameter of the compound eye, or slightly less than that diameter. The outline of the mandibles nearly square, each mandible with two marginal teeth.
distribution: In China recorded from Xuwen, Guangdong and from Yaxian, Sanya, Longshui, Fushan and Chengmai, Hainan; abroad widely distributed in the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, India, Sri Lanka, Papua New Guinea, Africa, Australia, the Caribbean coast, Central America and South America.
